svg.text: IntentBridge — the headless agent layer for telcos
AIforce agents act across BSS/OSS through governed TM Forum Open APIs
Headless by design · no new screens
TMF Open APIs as governed MCP tools
agents call tools, never systems directly
in the tools people already use
Ofcom · GDPR · EU AI Act · TSA
TMF = TM Forum Open API · ODA = Open Digital Architecture · A2A = agent-to-agent
✓ Proven in a working model: 16/16 Apex tests · 100% coverage · live demo
